# DronaHost
> Managed WordPress, cloud and VPS hosting, plus web design and SEO, for businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates and Europe.
> Uptime SLA: 99.99%. Money-back guarantee: 30-day. Support: 24/7. Site migration: Free. At renewal: Same price. Backups: Backups. Migration process: Migration.

## Hosting products

- **Managed WordPress hosting**: Automatic backups, a team that moves your existing site across and help by support ticket. Plans from $14.99/month, billed annually. https://dronahost.com/wordpress-hosting
- **Cloud hosting**: Flexible cloud hosting for sites and applications whose traffic changes over time and that need to grow without migrating. https://dronahost.com/cloud-web-hosting
- **VPS hosting**: Virtual private servers for applications, stores and teams that need dedicated resources and more control than shared hosting. https://dronahost.com/managed-vps-hosting
- **Business hosting**: Web hosting with a control panel for any kind of site. You manage the site and we run the hosting account. Email is not included. https://dronahost.com/business-hosting
- **Domain registration**: Register a domain name or transfer one you own, with help from the DronaHost team. https://dronahost.com/domains
- **Pricing**: Plan comparison with the renewal price shown beside the signup price. https://dronahost.com/pricing

## Services

- **Web design and development**: WordPress, React and Next.js websites scoped around what your business needs the site to do. https://dronahost.com/wordpress-website-design
- **Growth services**: Support for sites that are ready to grow: integrations, conversion work and ongoing improvement. https://dronahost.com/growth-services
- **SEO services**: Technical SEO, content strategy and link building on a monthly retainer. https://dronahost.com/seo-services
